claims.statement: ta-web is the new torrentearcano.com for Dofus guides, achievements, classes and checklists with member accounts and premium features, replacing the Squarespace site and the silvestre-checklist embeds.
The app runs Next.js 16, React 19 and Payload CMS 3.92 with the Postgres adapter, S3 storage and Sentry, on Node 24 and pnpm 11.
The target stack adds Better Auth for members, Drizzle for own tables and Postgres full-text search, running as one long-running Node container.
AGENTS.md says the app skeleton exists and most of the rest is planned, and paths named by rules but missing should be created with those names.

The Payload config registers twenty collections (quest guides, achievement pages, achievement groups, Dofus guides, checklists, pages, class pages, dungeon pages, media, quests, items, monsters, dungeons, NPCs, sub-areas, achievement categories, achievements, game data refreshes, redirects and users) and five globals (the Dofus guides index, the checklists index, site settings, index texts and navigation).
The home page renders a live strip, a hero with the quest search, the areas, a guide tour, the checklists and the author section.
Railway runs one web service in two environments, dev and production, from the same build.
openwiki/ is the only generated documentation; a daily scheduled task outside the repo refreshes it with the openwiki skill in update mode and opens a docs PR, while feature PRs do not touch it.
The hand-written docs superseded by openwiki/ live in docs/legacy/, kept for decisions and infrastructure state the code does not show.

The game data collections hold DofusDB data that nobody creates or deletes through the API or the panel; on quests, items, monsters, dungeons, NPCs and achievements a panel account can edit only the «Corrección de Torre» group, an administrator can edit only a sub-area's zone background, and achievement categories stay fully read-only.

pnpm data:refresh, with pnpm data:quests kept as an alias, copies DofusDB quests, items, monsters, dungeons, sub-areas, achievements and NPCs with their images and creates missing metalogros and achievement pages, writing only what changed, never deleting a row and never touching Torre's corrections.
The quest-guides collection keeps drafts and versions, lets anonymous readers see only published guides, and builds guide bodies from rich text, image, video, callout, fight, table and step blocks.
There are fifty-three committed migrations today.

scripts/import/ converts a cached Squarespace page into a quest guide draft with summary, start NPC and body blocks split into an introduction, steps and a closing, and collects what it could not convert as oddities; five demo guides are listed in GUIDE_SLUGS.

pnpm import:guides loads converted guides into quest-guides as drafts, storing each image once in media and linking the guide's DofusDB quest when the page names exactly one already in quests, and a re-run leaves unchanged guides untouched and never publishes.

Each quest stores its zone, its achievement and position in it, computed rewards for a level-200 character (experience, the experience at the optimal level, kamas, items and emote, spell, title and job IDs), its rewards per level tier when they change with the character's level, and needs (items, monsters and whether maps must be walked).

Picking a DofusDB quest for a guide fills its empty title, slug, SEO fields and summary live in the panel form; on save the server fills the SEO and summary only when the guide is created or its quest changes, the «Rellenar desde DofusDB» button fills them on request, and written values are never overwritten.
A quest guide links at most one DofusDB quest through an optional single relationship.

The design system components in src/components/ui and src/components/game, with PageEnhancements as their one client island, are rendered by the public guide page and by the /sistema catalog, which answers 404 in production.

Lighthouse CI enforces the DESIGN.md performance budgets, in four shards, on the home page, a seeded quest guide, a seeded achievement page, /metalogros, /guias-dofus, /checklists, a seeded Dofus guide and a seeded checklist.

Quest guides render publicly at /<slug> in a single reading column with the breadcrumb, quest giver, summary columns with the rewards bag, steps and the next quest card, with draft preview and revalidation on save.

Today the header and home searches match names in a JSON index served at GET /api/search/guides, holding published quest guides, achievement pages and metalogros plus the Dofus guides, checklists and standalone pages the menu links.

Achievement pages, Dofus guides, standalone pages and checklists share the /<slug> route with quest guides, the metalogros index lives at /metalogros, the Dofus guides index at /guias-dofus and the checklists index at /checklists.
pnpm import:achievements copies Torre's metalogros index onto the metalogros and achievement pages, and pnpm guides:backfill brings earlier imported guides up to the current importer.
pnpm fix:achievements applies targeted corrections to the metalogros and achievement pages after the import without running the whole import again.
pnpm import:dofus-guides imports Torre's Dofus guide pages into dofus-guides and on a rerun keeps the fields Torre changed in the panel.
pnpm review:release runs an AI review of the changes entering the next release.
Panel accounts have an administrator or editor role, with the first account made an administrator and the last administrator protected.

pnpm import:checklists loads Torre's checklists from a silvestre-checklist copy, the ported ones (including the Ocre as a souls checklist) as drafts and the rest as in-preparation cards linking to Squarespace, keeping each step's stepId on a rerun.
src/lib/derive/checklist.ts computes checklist data from stored quests instead of hand-written text, replacing the old Python build step.
pnpm data:dungeon-notes prints only the dungeon note report of pnpm data:quests, without downloading or writing.
A checklist is either a steps checklist rendered by ChecklistView or a souls checklist rendered by SoulsView.
pnpm import:checklist-cards brings the poster art of the old checklists hub into each checklist's index card and the checklists index teaser.
A standalone page still «En preparación» at /<slug> redirects to its Squarespace page, and otherwise renders through SitePageView or answers 404.
The game data refresh also runs as a weekly Railway cron service in both environments, every Wednesday at 06:00 UTC with pnpm data:refresh --schedule, and a failed run is not retried automatically.
Each game data refresh leaves a row in «Refrescos de datos» and does not start when another refresh is already running, whether started by the script, the cron or the panel.
The home page reads its copy from the «Portada e índices» global, Torre's social links from «Ajustes del sitio» and its area sections from «Navegación».

The class-pages and dungeon-pages collections hold Torre's class builds and dungeon pages without a public page yet, feeding the menu's class and dungeon lists, and the navigation global holds the menu sections and the featured Dofus.
Amakna, Arcano, Bonta and Brâkmar are free themes with Amakna as the default, and Ocre stays premium.
pnpm zones:backgrounds fetches the zone background of every subarea a published page uses that still has none.

pnpm import:inventory downloads a new copy of Torre's Squarespace site and reports what changed page by page, and pnpm import:delta brings new and changed guides and achievement prose in without undoing Torre's panel edits; pnpm achievements:alineamiento creates the Alineamiento achievement pages.
Page views go to Umami through an inline script rendered only when umamiConfig allows it, and each /<slug> page renders an Article JSON-LD and uses its own share card.
